test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT the function of the central bank of the country?

options.text: It controls money supply of the country.
It acts as a banker to the government.
It accepts deposits from the public.
It issues the currency of the country.

solution:
The correct option is **accepts deposits from the public.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
